domain_restrictions: f is defined for all real inputs (so x plus 1 and x minus m are valid inputs)
m is a natural number and is coerced to an integer amount for subtraction from x
subtraction by m uses the real number obtained from m
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: If f(x plus 1) equals f(x) for every real x, then for every real x and every natural number m, f(x minus m) equals f(x).
quantifier_order: for all real x: f(x plus 1) equals f(x)
for all real x and for all natural m: f(x minus m) equals f(x)

variables.name: x
variables.role: input to f in both premise and conclusion

variables.name: m
variables.role: nonnegative integer shift amount used in the conclusion

statement_nl: If for every real number x one has f(x + 1) = f(x), then for every real number x and every natural number m, f(x - (m : ℝ)) = f(x).
